d: LamdaX builds scalable digital solutions and software that help organizations streamline business processes and turn data into actionable insights. Our work is focused on making technology practical, useful, and easy to adopt for the businesses we support.

As Sales Operations Manager, you will play a hands-on role in helping clients successfully implement and use LamdaX’s solutions. This role is centered on building strong client relationships, supporting adoption in the field, and ensuring teams at client branches are equipped to use the platform effectively.
q: At least 5 years of professional experience.
Experience promoting technology products or software within software, technology, or fintech companies.
Hands-on experience with software implementation and client onboarding.
Hands-on experience training end users and branch staff on a software platform.
Experience coordinating with client-side managers across branches.
Already in Riyadh or able to move there easily.
Able to work on-site whenever client meetings are scheduled.
r: Install QR codes at client branches.
Train employees on LamdaX’s Wafaa software.
Travel to each client branch as needed in Riyadh, KSA.
Coordinate a flexible work schedule directly with clients.
